raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified Princess Pauline of Württemberg’s parentage and nationality by claiming she was a daughter of Paul I of Russia and concluding her origin was Russia. In reality, Pauline was a German princess from the Kingdom of Württemberg (House of Württemberg). This incorrect inference, not supported by the sources surfaced, led to the wrong country.
